title: Sting-Sense
headline: Bus telemetry for route and congestion analysis
summary: Sting-Sense turns bus GPS and IMU data into route-level views of road quality and congestion. Its Streamlit and Folium workflow connects collected route data, traffic categorization, and interactive maps for transit-focused analysis.
problem: Transit telemetry is distributed across location and inertial streams, making route-level road quality and congestion patterns difficult to inspect together.
contribution: An application-oriented analytics workflow that combines collected GPS and IMU route data with traffic scoring, time filtering, and interactive map views.
pipeline: Load collected route and sensor CSV data.
Filter observations by route and time window.
Categorize traffic and route-level sensing signals.
Present results through Streamlit and Folium maps.
evidence: Collected route CSV files under real_data/.
Runnable Streamlit and map application entry points.
The Flash-Fusion v1 preprint extends this sensor-driven transportation analysis into a natural-language IoT workflow.
limitations: The root documentation is currently minimal. The linked preprint reflects the Sting-Sense-centered v1 system; a v2 aligned with the current Flash-Fusion submission is planned.
